newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 35 Kurdish rebels killed in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 35 Kurdish rebels killed in clashes.

text.p: Turkish security forces killed 35 Kurdish guerrillas in clashes over the last two days in southeast Turkey, the emergency rule governor's office said on Tuesday.
A statement from the governor's office said the clashes with the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels took place in Diyarbakir and Batman provinces.
More than 21,000 people have been killed in the 12-year-old armed struggle between Turkish troops and PKK guerrillas, who are fighting for autonomy or independence from Ankara.
